stories.title: A helping of hope: Raul Jimenez Thanksgiving Dinner brings San Antonio together for 47th year
stories.summary: Volunteers are preparing thousands of free meals at the Henry B. González Convention Center, where everyone is welcome to share food, friendship and holiday cheer.

stories.title: Man shot outside northwest side apartment during family’s pre-Thanksgiving gathering
stories.summary: Police say a stranger pushed the man and shot him in the leg before fleeing in a pickup. The victim was hospitalized in stable condition.

stories.title: Suspected impaired driver detained after rear-end crash on northwest side of town
stories.summary: Police say the man pulled a knife and threatened to harm himself while officers spoke with him after the crash. The SUV’s driver was not injured.

stories.title: Teen shot in the leg while walking home on west side, police say
stories.summary: The 14-year-old was taken to University Hospital in stable condition after reporting that he heard gunfire while walking near South Brazos Street.

stories.title: K9 helps uncover more than 130 pounds of fentanyl, meth hidden in car at Arizona border
stories.summary: CBP says officers detained an 18-year-old driver after finding drugs concealed throughout her vehicle at the San Luis Port of Entry.

stories.title: Thanksgiving pet safety: What not to feed your dog or cat
stories.summary: Thanksgiving foods can pose risks to pets, warns Debbie Proulx of the Gulf Coast Humane Society. Keep onions, chocolate, and xylitol away and opt for plain turkey.

stories.title: ‘I just love them all’: Cibolo seniors share the blessings closest to their hearts
stories.summary: Handwritten notes and thankfulness trees helped residents at The Brooks of Cibolo celebrate family, friendship and the people who make life sweeter.

stories.title: ‘She didn’t deserve this’: Family seeks justice after 15-year-old daughter riding e-scooter killed in hit-and-run
stories.summary: Mary Krupp was just a couple minutes away from her home when authorities say a Ford pickup truck hit her head-on.

stories.title: San Antonio Botanical Garden, H-E-B team up to plant 2,500 native trees in Kerrville
stories.summary: The 2,500 trees planted in Kerrville represent a portion of the Garden’s broader goal to restore 50,000 native trees along the Guadalupe River over five years.

stories.title: San Antonio bike lane project could include two-way cycle track near Woodlawn Lake, councilwoman says
stories.summary: The District 1 City Council office has identified a portion of Cincinnati Avenue for the proposed project. It ran a survey with nearby residents last year.

stories.title: Turning on the heat in San Antonio? Here’s when a burning smell warrants a repair call.
stories.summary: The faint, dusty smell should fade within minutes. A Goettl HVAC expert explains when to call for service and why some heaters can run up electric bills.

stories.title: SAPD: Online purchase meetup leads to robbery, SWAT response at near Churchill High School
stories.summary: Two suspects were taken into custody after a man reported being assaulted and robbed during a meetup arranged for an online purchase.
